reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly assumes equimolar CoCrFeNiTi is a single-phase solid solution with high SFE; in reality, Ti additions strongly promote intermetallic phases and likely lower SFE, making the proposed mechanism physically unsound.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is detailed and would clearly falsify the hypothesis if the predicted strengthening and planar slip are not observed, but the test is built on a flawed material premise.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it is based on a fundamental misunderstanding of the alloy system, directing research effort toward an unlikely mechanism and an improbable single-phase state.
